title: Puharich hypnotizes Geller in Israel and the Nine come through
summary: Greg tells of Puharich hypnotizes Geller in Israel and the Nine come through, about 1970–1971 at Israel, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: has this whole episode in Israel before he even brings him back to the United States where he basically hypnotizes Geller and you know, the nine come through.

related.note: Hypnosis tapes in which Puharich himself suggests the Nine. This tells the Nine coming through under hypnosis as Puharich's leading questions rather than real contact, which is a different core claim about the same kind of session.

plain: A researcher named Greg, on Jesse Michels's podcast, describes something that he says happened in Israel around 1970 and 1971. He says Andrija Puharich, a scientist, hypnotized Uri Geller, a young Israeli man known for claimed psychic powers, before bringing him to the United States, and that "the Nine", a group described as an alien council, came through and spoke. Greg points to Puharich's own book about Geller and his tape recordings, and if true, this would be a recorded contact with non-human beings.
